newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Digitel says ahead on phone installations.
newsitem.headline: Digitel says ahead on phone installations.

text.p: Digital Telecommunications (Phils) Inc (Digitel), the telecommunications arm of JG Summit Holdings Inc, said on Monday it has installed 134,260 telephone lines in 1996.
The company said the figure brings to 204,184 the total number of fully digital telephone lines installed by Digitel since it implemented the programme in 1995.
Digitel senior vice-president William Pamintuan told Reuters the company exceeded its 202,000 total installed telephone lines target for 1996.
The company is required under local telecommunication laws to install 300,000 lines by January 1998.
Pamintuan said Digitel will be able to install the entire 300,000 lines on or before June this year.
